narr: Thunderstorms with heavy rain repeatedly moved over the same areas in Columbia, producing flash flooding.
ev: Richland County EM reported vehicle stranded in flooded roadway along I-77 North at the Shop Road Interchange.
USGS Gage at Rocky Branch Creek at Main and Whaley Streets reached 7.4 feet, above flood stage of 7.2 feet, cresting at 5:54 PM.
lsr: USGS Gage at Main & Whaley recorded 7.38 feet, flood stage 7.2 feet. Water flowing over roadways.
The USGS gage along Rocky Branch Creek reached flood stage at 553 pm. The creek crested at 554 pm at 7.4 feet.
Richland County EM reported a vehicle stuck in water along I-77 at mile marker 6A in the northbound lane. This is the I-77 and Shop Road interchange.
